capabilities.summary: Bracketed-script beat sync: parse a script with [spans] and snap animation cues to word timings from rightkit-transcript; typed errors on any mismatch, no fuzzy matching
policyNotes: Declaration-only: script parsing and word snapping are not an ownership fingerprint.
Consumes rightkit-transcript words; fuzzy ASR matching stays in rightkit-align.

capabilities.summary: Storyboard inspect sheets: plan and (feature assemble) compose rendered frames into sheets, six tiles per 2x3 sheet by default with a 480 px minimum tile width (defaults to confirm), with a rightkit.motion.sheets.v1 manifest
policyNotes: Declaration-only: sheet layout is not an ownership fingerprint.
No media decode or encode lives in this crate; callers decode frames through rightkit-ffmpeg.

capabilities.summary: Append-only checksummed take container for rendered frames (gated: not built until a producer is named)
policyNotes: Declaration-only and gated: the take module is not built; this capability reserves the name until a producer is named (decision record docs/design/motion-owner.md).
